reasoning_content: Dependencies use `libs.<name>` version catalog. Let's find the version catalog (gradle/libs.versions.toml) and check which group is in the io.swcode / sw-code group — those will probably be coming from GitHub Packages.

action.command: cd /workspace/backend && ls gradle/; find . -name "libs.versions.toml" -not -path "*/build/*" | head; echo ===; grep -inE "swcode|sw-code|github" gradle/libs.versions.toml 2>/dev/null | head -30

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /workspace/backend && ls gradle/; find . -name \"libs.versions.toml\" -not -path \"*/build/*\" | head; echo ===; grep -inE \"swcode|sw-code|github\" gradle/libs.versions.toml 2>/dev/null | head -30", "security_risk": "LOW", "summary": "Check version catalog for swcode/github deps"}

summary: Check version catalog for swcode/github deps
